blocks.en: In this section, we extend the notion of weak solution to strictly hyperbolic systems of conservation laws in one space dimension. As in the case of the wave equation, we will be able to observe discontinuous solutions. The use of the term \emph{shock wave} to describe a discontinuous weak solution originated in the study of gas dynamics, but now it is used in connection with any discontinuous solution of a hyperbolic problem.
blocks.zh: 在本节中, 将弱解概念推广到一维空间中的严格双曲守恒律方程组. 与波动方程的情形一样, 将会看到不连续解. 用\emph{激波}一词描述不连续弱解起源于气体动力学的研究, 如今则用于双曲问题的任意不连续解.
